top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 prize to Drucker, Holst and Mojsov is a mature, complete achievement: the incretin effect and proglucagon processing, identification of the biologically active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, and a validated drug class with randomized outcome-trial benefit in type 2 diabetes and obesity. Each discovery step has a distinct academic owner, the three-person allocation avoids cutting a core GLP-1 name or splitting the prize, and the citation scope (physiology and active form, therapy as consequence) is defensible. Late-stage safety questions concern use of a validated mechanism, not the discovery. No award is clearly inferior given this strength of evidence.
